name: new_tegomin
description: A Mincho (Japanese Serif) style font which has been drawn on a square grid. It takes inspiration from Mincho's clean and well organized appearance and the organic nature of handwritten letterforms. To contribute to the project, visit github.com/nagamaki008/NewTegomin
